nodes.description: Private owner address of the Ownable base contract; grants privileged access to onlyOwner functions.
Timestamp that gates the start of sale periods via the periodStarted modifier.
Number of NFTs still available to be minted; decremented in _popPendingAtIndex and used as randomness modulus.
bool[1002] mapping tracking which tokenIds have already been minted.
External IFacelessNFT contract used for minting and totalSupply queries.
uint16[10000] private array implementing the swap-remove pending token id list.
Current SaleStep enum controlling which sale modifier applies to functions.
Constant 1001 maximum NFT supply.
Constant 0.3 ether price per NFT during the second sale.
Owner-only function that changes the current sale step.
Owner-only function that sets the sale start timestamp; compares against block.timestamp.
Owner-only airdrop mint restricted to the Airdrop period, minting tokenIds in the 647-846 range.
Payable early-bird purchase of a specific tokenId in the 847-1001 range, minting to msg.sender.
Payable second-sale purchase of up to 20 randomly selected NFTs minted to msg.sender.
Owner-only function that forwards the whole contract balance to msg.sender via a low-level call.
Public view helper computing the pending token id at a given index.
Internal view that linearly scans the pending list for a tokenId and reverts if absent.
Internal pure price lookup by tokenId range for the early bird sale.
Internal swap-and-pop of the pending array; decrements pendingCount.
Internal function that picks a pseudo-random pending index and mints it to the buyer.
Internal view pseudo-random generator based on block.difficulty, block.timestamp and pendingCount.
Returns the current owner address.
Modifier requiring the caller to equal the stored owner; enforces access control.
Owner-only ownership transfer with zero-address check.
Owner-only function that sets the owner to the zero address.
Private setter writing the _owner state variable and emitting OwnershipTransferred.
Returns msg.sender; used by Ownable for the owner check.
Caller-controlled address, used for owner checks, mint recipients and the withdraw destination.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used for period gating and pseudo-randomness.
Low-level call forwarding the full balance to msg.sender before any state finalization; classic reentrancy sink.
pendingCount-- arithmetic on pendingCount inside a state-mutating swap-and-pop.
keccak256 over block.difficulty, block.timestamp and pendingCount, all predictable/manipulable.
SafeMath add/mul used for supply and payment checks in randomPurchase.
SaleStep value written to _currentSale.
New start timestamp validated against block.timestamp.
Recipient address of the airdrop mint.
Token id to look up and mint during the airdrop.
Token id purchased in the early bird sale; drives index lookup and price.
Number of NFTs to buy in the second sale, bounded to 20.
Index queried in the pending id array.
Token id searched for in the pending list.
Start offset of the pending scan range.
Number of pending slots to scan.
New owner address passed to _setOwner.
Recipient of the randomly selected mint.
Index removed from the pending array.
Resolved pending index for the airdropped token id.
Resolved pending index for the purchased token id.
Loop counter over the requested number of NFTs.
Loop counter over the scanned pending range.
Pending token id read from getPendingAtIndex during the scan.
Token id removed by the swap-and-pop.
Last pending token id moved into the popped slot.
Pseudo-random index derived from _getRandom and pendingCount.
Token id returned from the pop and minted.
Success flag returned by the low-level balance transfer call.
Previous owner address used in the OwnershipTransferred event.

onlyOwner modifier gates setStartTime.

renounceOwnership is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership delegates the write to _setOwner.
renounceOwnership zeroes the owner through _setOwner.

randomPurchase computes supply and payment checks with SafeMath add/mul.
msg.sender is the recipient of the full-balance low-level call.
msg.sender is the mint recipient in standardPurchase.
msg.sender is the mint recipient in randomPurchase.
msg.sender (via _msgSender) is compared with the owner in onlyOwner.
_msgSender returns the raw msg.sender value.
setStartTime validates the new start time against block.timestamp.
standardPurchase is gated by periodStarted comparing block.timestamp to startTime.
randomPurchase is gated by periodStarted comparing block.timestamp to startTime.
block.timestamp feeds the pseudo-random seed in _getRandom.

pendingCount bounds and is decremented by _popPendingAtIndex.

startTime is compared with block.timestamp in the periodStarted modifier.
startTime is compared with block.timestamp in the periodStarted modifier.

Parameter _startTime is only used to set the startTime state variable inside setStartTime.
Parameter to is only used as the mint recipient in airdropTransfer.
Parameter tokenId is only consumed by the airdrop index lookup and mint in airdropTransfer.
Parameter tokenId is only consumed by the index and price lookups in standardPurchase.
Parameter numberOfNfts only bounds the loop in randomPurchase.
Parameter _index only indexes the pending array in getPendingAtIndex.
Parameter tokenId is only the scan target of _getPendingIndexById.
Parameter startIndex is only the scan offset of _getPendingIndexById.
Parameter totalCount is only the scan bound of _getPendingIndexById.
Parameter newOwner is only validated and forwarded by transferOwnership.
Parameter _to is only the mint recipient in _randomMint.
Parameter _index is only the popped slot selector in _popPendingAtIndex.
Local nftIndex exists only to validate and pop within airdropTransfer.
Local nftIndex exists only to validate and pop within standardPurchase.
Loop counter i only drives the mint loop in randomPurchase.
Loop counter i only drives the scan in _getPendingIndexById.
Local pendingTokenId is only the comparison value in _getPendingIndexById.
Local tokenId is only the popped return value of _popPendingAtIndex.
